cells: Cannot be varied to their disadvantage after appointment

blocks.content: No person who is a member of a civil service of the Union or an all-India service or a civil service of a State or holds a civil post under the Union or a State shall be dismissed or removed by an authority subordinate to that by which he was appointed.

rows: Civil servants hold office during the pleasure of the President or Governor
Protects civil servants from arbitrary dismissal, removal, or reduction in rank
Applies to both defense personnel and civil servants
Applies exclusively to civil servants holding civil posts
Subject to specific constitutional tenure rules (e.g., Supreme Court Judges, CAG, CEC)
Inquiry can be waived for criminal conviction, impracticality, or national security

items: Article 311 protections apply strictly to civil servants and do not extend to defense personnel.
Departmental inquiry under Article 311 can be dispensed with on grounds of national security by the President or Governor.
Creation of new All India Services under Article 312 requires an initial resolution by the Rajya Sabha supported by at least two-thirds of members present and voting.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 309 empowers Parliament and state legislatures to regulate the recruitment and conditions of service of public servants.
Article 310 incorporates the 'Doctrine of Pleasure', specifying that members of the civil service hold office during the pleasure of the President or Governor.
Article 311 provides constitutional protection to civil servants against arbitrary dismissal, removal, or reduction in rank.
A civil servant cannot be dismissed or removed by an authority subordinate to the appointing authority.
Rajya Sabha holds the special power under Article 312 to pass a resolution creating new All India Services by a two-thirds majority.
